decisive_finding.cause: Catalog adoption and global authority use case-sensitive tool identity while request observations reject tool-name ambiguity case-insensitively.
decisive_finding.reproduction: Primary true and fallback TRUE can carry different executable authorities, survive catalog validation as separate map keys, and bind independently when either route is selected alone.
decisive_finding.impact: One symbolic tool can acquire multiple executable authorities through case aliases, defeating the global consistency and ambiguity-refusal contract.
decisive_finding.result: Material false-pass; source-local catalog acceptance is blocked.

smallest_safe_correction: Reject case-aliased primary and fallback tools during adoption and definition validation.
Key global symbolic-tool authority by one canonical case identity.
Add primary/fallback and cross-definition case-alias negatives while preserving exact same-authority reuse.
claim_ceiling: The routine production catalog remains a source-local REWORK candidate.
no_claim_statement: This review does not claim source acceptance, public execution, installation, runtime behavior, node closure, readiness, release, or completion.
